title: Comparing GenAI to Machine Learning and Manual Review for eDiscovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.16925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Keeling et al. [Keeling2026Generative] report on a case study recently conducted by Redgrave LLP in which they assert that Relativity's Generative AI Review tool (aiR) achieved 88% recall while Relativity Assisted Learning (RAL), its machine-learning tool, achieved 64% recall. These results are not comparable because the methods employed have different objectives, because of inter-assessor disagreement, and because they represent different recall-precision and cost-benefit trade-offs. Our analysis of the Redgrave data indicates that, when these differences are taken into account, aiR and manual review are comparable. Furthermore, established machine-learning models employing Continuous Active Learning (CAL) show state-of-the-art effectiveness, and superior efficiency, when trained only on a sample of 2,000 first-pass-reviewer responsiveness determinations.

translated_title: 比较生成式AI与机器学习和人工审查在电子证据开示中的应用
translated_abstract: Keeling等人[Keeling2026Generative]报告了Redgrave LLP最近开展的一项案例研究，他们声称Relativity的生成式AI审查工具获得了88%的召回率，而其机器学习工具Relativity Assisted Learning (RAL)仅达到64%的召回率。然而这些结果并不具有可比性，原因在于所采用的方法目标不同、评估者之间存在分歧，以及它们代表了不同的召回率-精确度权衡和成本-效益权衡。我们对Redgrave数据的分析表明，在考虑这些差异之后，aiR与人工审查的效果是相当的。此外，采用持续主动学习（CAL）的成熟机器学习模型，仅在2,000条初审人员相关性判定样本上进行训练，就能展现出最先进的有效性和更优越的效率。
tldr: 该研究指出此前声称生成式AI审查工具（88%召回率）优于机器学习工具（64%召回率）的结论因方法差异而不可比，实际分析发现生成式AI与人工审查效果相当，而采用持续主动学习（CAL）的机器学习模型仅需2,000条样本训练即可达到最先进效果并具备更高效率。
en_tdlr: This analysis shows that claims of GenAI (88% recall) outperforming machine learning (64% recall) are not comparable due to differing objectives and trade-offs; GenAI performs comparably to manual review, while Continuous Active Learning (CAL) models achieve state-of-the-art effectiveness with superior efficiency using only a 2,000-document training sample.
